items.name: hook_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a popular science and geography YouTube Shorts channel. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: brisk and curious, with natural emphasis and a short comic pause before each punchline. Chars voices funny cartoon characters, short and punchy. The opening is a bold dare to the viewer: punchy, confident, a beat of wonder on 'upside down', a short beat before 'So how?'.
lines: That's a real one point seven tonne car. It flew over a truck and hung upside down.
